numeric_reference.runtime: The scope of numeric_reference is exactly the complete A08 contrast path plus A09 pixel_preprocessing.srgb conversion; it does not claim to define A09 SVD, detrending, correlation, autocorrelation, silhouette fitting or motion statistics. Within that limited scope, the normative reference is Java 21 strict floating-point evaluation and java.lang.StrictMath under the exact JBR 21 java executable and release-file digests already bound by toolchain-lock.json. A driver adapter or helper is not an authority and may not replace these inline algorithms; its source/class digests are retained only as implementation evidence, while every retained input/output raw-bit record must be reproducible from this frozen contract and the bound JBR.
numeric_reference.binary64_contract: Within the declared numeric_reference scope, every literal has the written Java double value; every +, -, *, / and comparison is one Java binary64 operation in the written order with round-to-nearest ties-to-even. StrictMath.pow, StrictMath.cbrt and StrictMath.sqrt are the only transcendental operations and provide the unique reproducible StrictMath reference result. Every input, intermediate selected for a branch, and output must be finite; otherwise FAIL. Retained values serialize as exactly 16 lowercase hexadecimal digits from Double.doubleToRawLongBits, with -0.0 normalized to +0.0 before serialization.
numeric_reference.srgb_to_linear_pseudocode: srgb(q): require integer 0<=q<=255; C=((double)q)/255.0d; if (C<=0.04045d) return C/12.92d; n=C+0.055d; b=n/1.055d; return StrictMath.pow(b,2.4d). No expression reassociation is allowed.
numeric_reference.oklab_and_distance_pseudocode: Clamp R,G,B independently with ordered comparisons to [0.0d,1.0d]. l0=0.4122214708d*R; l1=0.5363325363d*G; l2=l0+l1; l3=0.0514459929d*B; l=l2+l3. Compute m and s in the identical written two-products-then-add-then-third-product-then-add order from coefficients 0.2119034982/0.6806995451/0.1073969566 and 0.0883024619/0.2817188376/0.6299787005. lp=StrictMath.cbrt(l), mp=StrictMath.cbrt(m), sp=StrictMath.cbrt(s). L=((0.2104542553d*lp)+(0.7936177850d*mp))-(0.0040720468d*sp); a=((1.9779984951d*lp)-(2.4285922050d*mp))+(0.4505937099d*sp); b=((0.0259040371d*lp)+(0.7827717662d*mp))-(0.8086757660d*sp). distance: dL=L1-L2; da=a1-a2; db=b1-b2; q0=dL*dL; q1=da*da; q2=db*db; q3=q0+q1; q4=q3+q2; return StrictMath.sqrt(q4).
numeric_reference.coordinate_pseudocode: For the retained ring, derive integer xlo=min(px), xhi=max(px), ylo=min(py), yhi=max(py) in ascending-y-then-x enumeration and require xhi>xlo and yhi>ylo. For any retained ring or character-box pixel center (px,py): xd=(double)(px-xlo); xs=(double)(xhi-xlo); x0=2.0d*xd; x1=x0/xs; x=x1-1.0d; compute y by the identical sequence using ylo/yhi. The design row is constructed in order v[0]=1.0d, v[1]=x, v[2]=y, v[3]=x*y.
numeric_reference.weighted_solve_pseudocode: Set every M[p][q] and z[p] to +0.0d. For i=0..n-1, p=0..3, q=0..3 in that nesting order: t0=w[i]*v[i][p]; t1=t0*v[i][q]; M[p][q]=M[p][q]+t1. After the q loop, u0=w[i]*v[i][p]; u1=u0*channel[i]; z[p]=z[p]+u1. For k=0..3 choose pivot r in k..3 by greatest StrictMath.abs(M[r][k]), lowest r on an exact tie; require abs pivot>1.0e-12d, swap complete rows and z entries; pivot=M[k][k]; for j=k..3 ascending set M[k][j]=M[k][j]/pivot, then z[k]=z[k]/pivot. For r=k+1..3 ascending: factor=M[r][k]; for j=k..3 ascending set product=factor*M[k][j], then M[r][j]=M[r][j]-product; productZ=factor*z[k]; z[r]=z[r]-productZ. Back substitute i=3..0: acc=z[i]; for j=i+1..3 ascending set product=M[i][j]*coef[j], then acc=acc-product; coef[i]=acc/M[i][i]. OLS uses all w=1.0d. Each of exactly ten IRLS refits computes residual=((coef[0]+coef[1]*x)+coef[2]*y)+coef[3]*(x*y) in that order from the preceding fit, ar=StrictMath.abs(channel-residual), and w=1.0d when ar<=2.0d/255.0d else (2.0d/255.0d)/ar; no early exit or alternate solver is allowed.

all contrast arithmetic, sRGB conversion, OKLab conversion and Euclidean distance must conform to numeric_reference under the exact toolchain-locked JBR; any use of host libm, java.lang.Math, expression reassociation or a non-finite intermediate is FAIL, and retained raw-bit inputs and outputs must be independently reproducible without trusting the driver adapter

decode each lossless screenshot as sRGB and for each character box take the clipped three-pixel exterior ring after excluding every other character box; enumerate ring pixels in ascending y then x, require at least 24 pixels, map every ring and character-box pixel center with numeric_reference.coordinate_pseudocode, set each design row by that same contract, and fit Bc(x,y)=a+b*x+c*y+d*x*y independently for linear R, G and B: initialize all weights to one, solve, then run exactly 10 Huber IRLS refits without early exit using the preceding fit; every accumulation, pivot choice, pivot-row normalization, lower-row update, back-substitution term and coefficient is evaluated in the exact loop nesting and operation order of numeric_reference.weighted_solve_pseudocode; an underspecified or alternate solver, a pivot absolute value <=1e-12 or a non-finite coefficient is FAIL

inside each non-whitespace character box, form the glyph candidate mask from pixels whose frozen OKLab distance from the fitted local background exceeds 0.04; an isolated pixel means a candidate with zero candidate neighbors among its eight Chebyshev-distance-one neighbors and is removed; enumerate remaining 8-connected components using seed pixels in ascending y then x and neighbors in ascending y then x, retain every component whose pixel count is at least ceil(0.0025*inclusive_character_box_pixel_count), require at least eight retained pixels whose union stays within that character box, and fail if any character has no complete measurable mask

do not invert antialias alpha or infer a latent foreground color; for the union of retained glyph-mask components in one character box, compute each pixel's OKLab distance d from its fitted local background, sort pixels by descending d then ascending y then x, set core_count=max(5,ceil(0.10*N)) for N retained pixels, require N>=8, and select exactly the first core_count actual screenshot pixels as that character's deterministic core

for every selected core pixel use its actual linear-light screenshot RGB P and the fitted linear-light background B at the same coordinate, clamp each B channel to [0,1], compute relative luminance as 0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B and contrast as (max(Lp,Lb)+0.05)/(min(Lp,Lb)+0.05); retain every selected coordinate, P, B, distance and ratio, and report the minimum ratio over all selected core pixels of every character and then every text node; any selected pixel below 4.5:1 is FAIL

normal_motion_measurement.pixel_preprocessing: decode PNG bytes to unpremultiplied 8-bit sRGB, require opaque pixels, convert every channel through numeric_reference.srgb_to_linear_pseudocode under the exact toolchain-locked JBR, retain the 256-entry q-to-raw-binary64 lookup actually used, and perform no resize, blur, lossy conversion, optical-flow warp or frame registration
normal_motion_measurement.change_mask: inside hero_roi, include a pixel-channel vector only when at least one original 8-bit sRGB channel has max(frame)-min(frame) at least 2; subtract its 60-frame temporal mean, concatenate RGB vectors, and fail if the resulting matrix is empty
normal_motion_measurement.pixel_signal: compute the thin SVD X=U*diag(S)*Vt of the mean-centered changing-pixel matrix, treat S[1] as zero when only one singular value exists, and fail when S[0] is zero or the largest two singular values differ by at most 1e-9 relative to S[0]; define the raw first-component score exactly as U[:,0]*S[0], find the smallest Vt[0] column index among entries having the exact maximum absolute loading, and if that loading is negative multiply both Vt[0,:] and the score by -1; this canonical sign is independent of every silhouette result; remove the score's least-squares linear trend and require S[0]^2/sum(S^2) to be at least 0.60
normal_motion_measurement.autocorrelation: for detrended samples x[0..59], compute rho(k)=sum(i=0..59-k-1,x[i]*x[i+k])/sqrt(sum(i=0..59-k-1,x[i]^2)*sum(i=0..59-k-1,x[i+k]^2)); among strict local maxima for integer lags 10..30 select the unique largest rho at k, compute delta=0.5*(rho(k-1)-rho(k+1))/(rho(k-1)-2*rho(k)+rho(k+1)), refined_lag=k+delta and period=refined_lag/5.000; a tied maximum, k at a search boundary, abs(delta)>1, zero denominator or rho(k)<0.60 is FAIL
normal_motion_measurement.silhouette_mask: for each frame, take the 8-pixel hero_roi perimeter and fit Bc(x,y)=a+b*x+c*y+d*x*y independently for sRGB R, G and B using OLS followed by exactly 10 Huber IRLS iterations with delta=2/255 and weight min(1,delta/abs(residual)); convert the fitted field to OKLab, select pixels with distance at least 0.08, remove components smaller than 0.05 percent of hero_roi, close with a Chebyshev-radius-1 square structuring element, fill enclosed holes, retain the largest 8-connected component intersecting the central 20-percent rectangle and containing at least one low-chroma L>=0.70 white-hair seed, and explicitly exclude disconnected glow pixels; missing or edge-clipped masks are FAIL
normal_motion_measurement.silhouette_motion_signal: for each retained mask compute inclusive width w, height h, area and centroid cx,cy; form rows [w/median(w),h/median(h),(cx-median(cx))/median(w),(cy-median(cy))/median(h)], discard constant columns and center the remainder to matrix Y; compute thin SVD Y=U*diag(S)*Vt, treat S[1] as zero when only one singular value exists, and fail if Y has no column, S[0] is zero or the largest two singular values differ by at most 1e-9 relative to S[0]; define the raw first-component score exactly as U[:,0]*S[0], find the smallest Vt[0] column index among entries having the exact maximum absolute loading, and if that loading is negative multiply both Vt[0,:] and the score by -1; detrend that independently signed score linearly and require its absolute Pearson correlation with pixel_signal to be at least 0.50
normal_motion_measurement.inside_hero_attribution: form the swept-character mask as the union of all 60 silhouette masks; every changing pixel must either lie in that union or belong to an 8-connected change-mask component that intersects an 8-pixel dilation of the swept-character mask and whose temporal linear-light RGB vector has absolute Pearson correlation at least 0.80 with pixel_signal; these latter components are the only accepted attached-glow pixels
normal_motion_measurement.outside_hero_rule: the exact pixel complement application_content_bounds minus hero_roi is byte-identical in all 60 frames; the named lore, grid and control ROIs are retained only as diagnostic subsets and cannot substitute for this full-complement comparison
normal_motion_measurement.period_rule: the dominant normalized-autocorrelation period from the changing-pixel signal is between 4.5 and 5.1 seconds inclusive and agrees within 0.2 seconds with the period produced by the same formula over the silhouette_motion_signal
normal_motion_measurement.amplitude_rule: let wm, hm, cxm and cym be the medians of mask width, height and centroid; amplitude_percent=100*max over all frames of abs(w-wm)/wm, abs(h-hm)/hm, abs(cx-cxm)/wm and abs(cy-cym)/hm, and require amplitude_percent<=1.5

event_binding_contract.clock: the instrumentation records action-dispatch immediately before invoking the scoped AccessibilityNodeInfo action or Android back action, action-complete immediately after its successful return, accessibility-event callback, hierarchy capture-start, hierarchy capture-complete, frame capture-start immediately before invoking UiAutomation.takeScreenshot(), and frame capture-complete immediately after the returned pixels have been copied into the immutable lossless frame buffer, all from Android SystemClock.uptimeMillis on the same device for R02-R14; a frame's selection timestamp is its capture-start value, wall-clock timestamps cannot select stable_start, and missing, reversed or reused start/complete pairs are FAIL
event_binding_contract.candidate_event_predicate: event packageName must equal dev.lilies.civilizationseed; eventType must be TYPE_WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED (32) or TYPE_WINDOW_CONTENT_CHANGED (2048); for TYPE_WINDOW_CONTENT_CHANGED the source must be non-null, belong to the application package and have the same windowId as the captured target hierarchy root; for TYPE_WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED a non-null source must meet the same package/window rule and a null source is allowed only when the event windowId equals the target hierarchy root; eventTime must be at or after the action-dispatch timestamp; retain eventType, contentChangeTypes, windowId, source class, source viewId, source text/content-description and callback sequence
event_binding_contract.signature_grammar: each transition signature is exactName|role or exactName|role|selected=true; exactName must match exactly one visible node's text or content-description, role is the frozen controller's Android-class-to-role mapping, selected=true additionally requires AccessibilityNodeInfo.isSelected; required signatures must each resolve once and absent signatures must resolve zero times
event_binding_contract.target_match: after every candidate event, synchronously capture the complete application hierarchy; canonicalize nodes in depth-first child-index order as windowId, class, role, text, content-description, checked, selected, enabled and bounds; a target matches only when every required signature and absence predicate in transition_targets satisfies signature_grammar in that one hierarchy
event_binding_contract.selection_and_ties: the qualifying target event is the first candidate in instrumentation callback sequence whose bound hierarchy matches; callback sequence is a strictly increasing integer assigned before hierarchy capture and resolves equal eventTime ties; a second different hierarchy matching before the selected capture completes, no match within 1000ms after action completion, or any missing event/source/window field required by the predicate is FAIL
event_binding_contract.stable_frame_binding: stable_start is the first frame in capture-request sequence whose capture-start timestamp is at or after the chosen target hierarchy capture-complete timestamp; every retained frame binds its capture-start, capture-complete, immutable pixel-buffer SHA-256 and request sequence, capture-start must precede or equal capture-complete, and at least three frames from stable_start onward must exist

layer_1.contents: sorted entry for every regular file recursively below artifacts/: normalized relative path, byte size, raw-byte SHA-256, media type, producer receipt id and covered A01-A10 case ids
layer_1.exclusions: none below artifacts/; evidence-leaves.json never lists or hashes itself

layer_2.contents: schema/oracle/brief/baseline/toolchain/assignment ids and digests, accepted commit and tree, final APK path/size/SHA-256, exact raw-byte SHA-256 of evidence-leaves.json, A01-A09 result paths and digests, A10 pre-review runtime/integrity check digests, required-artifact coverage result and status ready_for_independent_review
layer_2.exclusions: does not list or hash evidence-manifest.json, independent-review.json or closure-envelope.json

independent_review.inputs: frozen Stage Contract, brief, oracle, baseline and toolchain; accepted commit/diff; assignment/model/token/tool ledger; evidence-manifest.json and all files reachable through evidence-leaves.json
independent_review.required_fields: fresh read-only reviewer identity/context, reviewed evidence-manifest raw-byte SHA-256, reconstructed A01-A09 verdicts, reconstructed A10 pre-review runtime/integrity verdict, confirmation that only the review and closure-envelope steps remain, blocker list, independence attestation and final PASS verdict
independent_review.rule: the reviewer does not mutate either manifest; any blocker, missing case or digest mismatch is FAIL

closure_envelope.producer: deterministic closure controller after the independent review
closure_envelope.contents: task/oracle/brief ids, accepted commit/tree, final APK SHA-256, evidence-manifest raw-byte SHA-256, independent-review raw-byte SHA-256, A01-A09 PASS ids, satisfied A10 pre-review/review/envelope predicates, final A10 PASS, ten total PASS case ids, zero-blocker assertion and terminal closure verdict
closure_envelope.rule: does not hash itself and is not referenced by either manifest or the independent review

evidence_graph.acyclicity_rule: construct directed edges from each JSON control file to every file digest it references; permitted levels are evidence-leaves.json to artifacts, evidence-manifest.json to evidence-leaves.json and artifacts, independent-review.json to evidence-manifest.json, and closure-envelope.json to evidence-manifest.json plus independent-review.json. Reject self-edges, duplicate paths, missing targets, reverse edges, any artifact reference to a control file and every cycle found by full depth-first traversal.

checks: no crash, ANR or FATAL EXCEPTION occurs during the frozen smoke
sanitized logcat, package dump, UI hierarchy and screenshots are retained
the repository includes test source and the executed test receipt names each test case and result
README Chinese-first, offline, storage and verification clauses are reported
evidence-leaves.json covers every regular file below artifacts/ exactly once and every path, size and raw-byte SHA-256 re-verifies

evidence-manifest.json binds the exact leaf-manifest digest, frozen inputs, assignment ledger, accepted commit/tree, APK, A01-A09 results and A10 pre-review checks without a self or forward reference and reports ready_for_independent_review rather than a premature terminal PASS

a fresh independent reviewer reads only the declared review inputs, reconstructs A01-A09 and the A10 pre-review checks, verifies all reachable bytes, confirms that the two post-manifest steps are the only remaining predicates and returns PASS with zero blockers bound to the exact evidence-manifest digest
the deterministic closure-envelope binds the unchanged evidence-manifest and independent-review digests, ten PASS cases, accepted commit/tree and APK digest without any manifest or review mutation
the complete reference graph satisfies the frozen level rules and full depth-first traversal reports zero cycles, zero missing targets and zero unreferenced files below artifacts/
cases.pass_condition: The two-layer manifest verifies byte-for-byte before review, the independent review is PASS with zero blockers, and the final closure-envelope binds both immutable digests. A missing artifact, digest mismatch, graph cycle, self-reference, forward reference, post-review manifest mutation or absent closure-envelope is FAIL.

prohibited_substitutions: source inspection for a runtime assertion
model or implementer self-report for a measured assertion
a screenshot without the matching package, commit and APK digest
a test that reads application source or private oracle expectations at runtime
post_oracle_closure_conditions: all A01 through A10 cases are PASS
the immutable two-layer evidence manifest verifies every artifact and contains no reference cycle
a fresh read-only independent reviewer reconstructs the contract and returns PASS with zero blockers bound to the exact evidence-manifest digest
a deterministic closure-envelope created after review binds the unchanged evidence-manifest digest and independent-review digest and reports terminal PASS
stop_conditions: any hard budget reaches its limit
provider usage is unknown or cannot be reconciled
the assignment asks for wider paths, commands, network, secrets or side effects
the same build or test fingerprint occurs three consecutive times
two consecutive iterations create no new acceptable diff
the clean emulator still fails twice after one clean rebuild
any mandatory final oracle case fails
